Returns all registered translatable entities with their translatable fields.
Each entry contains the entity name (PascalCase) and an array
of field names that are marked as translatable.

types.name: getTranslatableEntities
types.description:
Returns all registered translatable entities with their translatable fields.
Each entry contains the entity name (PascalCase) and an array
of field names that are marked as translatable.
types.example: import { DmlEntity } from "@medusajs/framework/utils" const translatables = DmlEntity.getTranslatableEntities() // Returns: [{ entity: "Store", fields: ["name"] }]

children.name: fields
children.description: The list of translatable property names
